info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Partner Application-spec
info.description: The Partner Application Management API enables businesses to initiate and submit applications for partnership programs. This API facilitates the creation of partner applications, allowing organizations to engage with potential partners efficiently. Users can utilize this endpoint to streamline the onboarding process, ensuring that all necessary application details are captured accurately. Typical consumers include business developers and partnership managers looking to enhance their partner ecosystems.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a new application for partnership. The request should include all necessary details to evaluate the application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit new partner application data. It should contain all required fields necessary for creating a partner application. Please ensure that the data format adheres to the defined schema to avoid validation errors.
